title: Beautiful experience for two
text: We booked this for our honeymoon and it was a wonderful experience. We were offered a bottle of sparkling wine and were given the option of going swimming or going through the old part of town. The guide was great.
author: Marcela_B

title: The boat ride was...
text: The boat ride was amazing!  The gentleman who took us was very friendly and made the ride very enjoyable.  He was very passionate about sailing and that’s what made it so great.  I would do it again if I ever come back.
author: Christopher_G

title: Book it!!
text: We had a wonderful time on our tour. You can control a lot of things, but you can’t control the weather. It was cold. The skies were grey. The sea was choppy. BUT, Carlos (our tour guide) was amazing. He made sure we had blankets and gave us a few options of how our trip could go. We decided to go to the old harbor and spent a lot of the time there, as it was much calmer water. We got to see amazing views of the city, enjoyed wonderful food, and beer/cava. He let us pick the music and offered to let us drive the boat for a bit. We loved every second. He also gave us a recommendation for the be
author: Holly_G

title: Wonderful trip with family
text: Unforgettable experience! The trip was perfectly organized, with delicious food and drinks served throughout the journey. We even had the chance to swim in the open sea! And most importantly, our captain Carlos was incredibly kind and truly wonderful.
author: Sightsee22814882111

title: Well worth the upgrade to have a private boat trip rather than a group
text:
We booked a private sailing rather than the group one and I’m so glad we did. 
If there were 8 people (from different groups) on the boat it would have felt too cramped but having it to ourselves felt great.
There were plenty of drinks options and the snacks were great, and as we are both gluten free our diets were catered for.
author: Laura_F

title: Fabulous!
text: We had so much fun! Mark did a great job and explained to us the skyline of barcelona. The snacks were fabulous and vibes were high!!
author: Margaret_C

title: Unreal
text: So good   mark/marc was an unbelievable tour guide,  so friendly , looked after us , what a trip  would recommend to anyone..boat was perfect , tour guide was amazing , thanks again
author: Paul_H

title: Great Experience!
text: What a wonderful activity! Our captain Alessio  was the perfect host and made sure our experience was positive. We were served local cheese, bread sticks, cured meat, etc., and toasted to our journey with a bottle of cava. The vibe was pleasant, with great music and friendly banter. Very relaxing, and we would do it again!
author: Erika_M

title: Fiona was wonderful!
text: Our captain, Fiona, was fabulous. Highly recommended! She ensured that our entire family had a comfortable sail, and a swim in the beautiful sea.
author: Katherine_W

title: A fun and comfortable...
text: A fun and comfortable experience, with outstanding work by the boatman. Great conversations to top it off.
author: Vibhor_K
